mapper.select: SELECT /* WebSocketMapper.getCHatHistory */ CHAT_ID , ROOM_ID , SENDER_ID , CONTENT , SEND_TIME , CHAT_TYPE FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY SEND_TIME ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE /* WebSocketMapper.deleteOldChatMessage (오래된 채팅 메시지 삭제) */ FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE SEND_TIME < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
